decision_rule: Run and report both tasks with the same fixed candidate and baseline. For a replicated G01 quality-and-efficiency claim, both pairs must produce sealed, native-scored predictions and the candidate must strictly improve Span-F1 and File-F1 while reducing known model tokens and measured run duration on each task. Any failed gate rejects replication; an unscored arm is inconclusive, never a win. The earlier GitHub CLI qualification and these two tasks remain insufficient for a full cross-benchmark product claim.
gold_posture: Only source-only task records used for selection and dispatch; no gold or previous predictions for these exact instances were inspected before freeze.
open_questions: Will the fixed shortlist improve quality beyond GitHub CLI?
How stable are token and duration gains across languages and repositories?
